blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Turning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) into strong dense retrievers typically requires some form of retriever training. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can instead be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval given only a few in-context examples. To answer this, we introduce RICE ( R epresentations from I n- C ontext E xamples), a simple “training-free” approach that extracts high-quality dense representations from LLMs. To do so, RICE conditions the LLM on examples that provide a shared context for query and document encoding. Our results demonstrate that RICE embeddings can substantially improve the accuracy of prompt-based LLM embeddings, establishing it as a simple method to build LLM-based dense retrievers that do not require training. We release our code at https://github.com/nourj98/RICE .
blocks.zh: 将只有解码器的大型语言模型(LLMs)变成强密的检索器一般需要某种形式的检索器训练. 在本文中,我们询问是否可以鼓励有限责任公司为大量检索提供有效的说明,仅举几个内容内的例子。 为了回答这个问题,我们采用了RICE(In-C ontext E xamples的R介绍),这是一种简单的“无培训”方法,它从LLMs中提取出高质量的密集表述。 为此,RICE将提供共享查询和文档编码上下文的例子作为LLM的条件. 我们的结果表明,RICE嵌入可以大幅度提高即时LLM嵌入的精度,将其确立为一种简单的方法来建造不需要培训的基于LLM的密集检索器. 我们在https://github.com/nourj98/RICE发布我们的代码. 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful backbones for modern dense retrieval systems thanks to their rich world knowledge and text understanding capabilities Zhang et al. (2025) . But “out-of-the-box”, their hidden states do not automatically yield effective embedding representations for dense retrieval. As a result, strong LLM-based dense retrieval systems typically rely on additional retriever training, often through supervised Ma et al. (2024) ; Thakur et al. (2025) or unsupervised BehnamGhader et al. (2024) ; BehnamGhader et al. (2026) objectives. Building strong LLM-based embeddings that require no training remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型因其丰富的世界知识和文本理解能力而成为现代密集检索系统的强大支柱 张等 (2025). 但是,“箱外”的隐藏状态并不能自动产生有效嵌入的表示,以便进行密集检索。 因此,强大的基于LLM的密集检索系统通常依赖额外的检索器培训,通常通过受监督的Ma等人(2024年)进行; Thakur等人(2025年)或无监督的BehnamGhader等人(2024年);Behnam Ghader等人(2026年)的目标。 建立无需培训的基于LLM的牢固嵌入体仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: In this paper, we seek to address this challenge by drawing on two insights from the broader literature on zero- and few-shot dense retrieval. The first is that, given only a few human-labeled in-context examples, LLMs can be prompted to produce effective task-specific synthetic data for training downstream dense retrievers Dai et al. (2023) ; Gwon et al. (2025) . But as we aim to build LLM dense retrievers that do not require training, we draw on a second insight from PromptReps Zhuang et al. (2024) , which demonstrated that LLMs can be directly prompted to generate query and document representations for retrieval. However, one limitation of PromptReps is that query and document representations are derived independently via separate prompts, without any shared context connecting the two encoding tasks.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们寻求通过从关于零射和几射密集检索的更广泛的文献中汲取两个见解来应对这一挑战。 首先是,鉴于只有少数人类标记的文字实例,可以促使LLMs生成针对具体任务的有效合成数据,用于培训下游密集检索器。 Dai et al. (2023); Gwon et al. (2025). 但当我们的目标是建造不需要训练的LLM稠密检索器时,我们借鉴了FournalReps Zhuang等人(2024年)的第二个见解,这说明LLMS可以直接诱导生成查询和文档表达以供检索. 然而,即时检索的一个限制是,查询和文档表示是通过单独的提示独立生成的,没有任何共享上下文连接两个编码任务.

blocks.en: Inspired by these insights, we ask: Can LLMs be prompted, using only a few in-context examples, to produce effective representations for dense retrieval? To answer this, we introduce RICE ( R epresentations from I n- C ontext E xamples), an approach for prompting LLMs to produce high-quality dense representations without requiring any form of retrieval-specific training. To do so, RICE combines the ease and simplicity of directly prompting LLMs for representations with the ability of LLMs to infer task-specific retrieval cues from only a few in-context examples.
blocks.zh: 受这些见解的启发,我们问:能否仅仅利用几个内容内的例子,促使有限责任公司为大量检索提供有效的表述? 为了回答这个问题,我们引入了RICE(来自In-C ontext E xamples的R介绍),这是一种促使LLMs制作高质量密集表述而不需要任何形式的检索专用培训的方法. 为此,RICE将直接促进LLMs进行表达的简单易行与LLMs从几个内容内的例子推断出特定任务检索提示的能力结合起来.

blocks.en: Like PromptReps, RICE derives embeddings by prompting an LLM to generate a representative word for a query or document and extracting its final hidden state. Unlike PromptReps, which relies on an instruction alone, RICE primes this word generation process using query–document pairs that illustrate how the LLM itself represents the given document through PromptReps-generated words. These demonstrations provide a shared context for query and document encoding with the aim of producing representations whose inner products better reflect relevance.
blocks.zh: 和ProactionReps一样,RICE通过提示LLM生成一个查询或文档的代表性单词并提取其最终的隐藏状态来生成嵌入. 与仅依赖一个指令的PowerReps不同,RICE质素使用查询 - 文件对来说明LLM本身如何通过PowerReps生成的单词来代表给定的文档. 这些演示为查询和文件编码提供了共同的背景,目的是制作其内部产品更好地反映相关性的表述。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are twofold. First, we propose RICE, a simple approach for extracting – via prompts – dense retrieval representations from LLMs using only in-context examples. Second, we comprehensively evaluate RICE on various retrieval datasets from BEIR Thakur et al. (2021) , and show that with only a few in-context examples, LLMs can produce strong representations for dense retrieval without requiring retrieval-specific training. In particular, we demonstrate that RICE improves the effectiveness of prompt-based LLM representations. When compared against other dense retrieval approaches that also work directly “out-of-the-box”, like HyDE Gao et al. (2023) , RICE achieves the highest average accuracy among these evaluated approaches. When compared against LLM2Vec-Gen BehnamGhader et al. (2026) , a highly effective self-supervised dense retriever, RICE is competitive. While RICE is less effective than dense retrievers trained on large collections of high-quality data, our findings show that in-context examples can offer a promising approach for narrowing the effectiveness gap between training-free, prompt-based retrieval and supervised dense retrievers.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献是双重的。 首先,我们提议RICE,一种简单的方法,通过提示从LLMs中提取密集的检索表示,只使用内容内的例子。 第二,我们全面评估RICE从BEIR Thakur等人(2021年)获得的各种检索数据集,并表明只有几个内容内的例子,LLMS可以产生强大的表示,进行密集检索,而不需要进行具体的检索培训。 特别是,我们表明,信息、通信和通信中心可提高即时LLM表述的有效性。 与HyDE Gao等人(2023年)等其他同样直接“外出”的密集检索方法相比,RICE在这些评估方法中实现了最高平均准确性。 与LLM2Vec-Gen Behnam相比 Ghader等人(2026年)是一个非常有效的自我监督密集的检索器,RICE具有竞争力. 与接受过大量高质量数据收集培训的密集检索人员相比,RICE没有那么有效,但我们的研究结果表明,文本中的例子可以提供一个有希望的办法,缩小无培训、快速检索和受监督的密集检索人员之间的效能差距。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we first review the dense variant of PromptReps (PromptReps-Dense). We then introduce RICE, a method that prompts LLMs to produce dense representations conditioned on in-context exemplars.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先审查"快速回转"(PromptReps-Dense)的密集变体. 然后,我们引入了RICE,这种方法促使LLMs产生以内容内实例为条件的密集表示.

blocks.en: 2.1 Preliminaries: PromptReps-Dense
blocks.zh: 2.1 初步情况: 快速还原

blocks.en: The core idea behind PromptReps Zhuang et al. (2024) is that LLMs can be directly prompted to generate effective representations for retrieval. For PromptReps, this is achieved by extracting the final hidden-state representation that the LLM produces when it is prompted to generate a representative word which summarizes a given input text.
blocks.zh: PowerReps Zhuang等人(2024年)背后的核心思想是,LLMS可以直接被催生出有效的表达供检索. 对于 PowerReps 来说,这是通过提取 LLM 当生成一个代表词时产生的最终隐藏状态的表达式来实现的,该代表词会总结给定的输入文本.

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
We hypothesize that PromptReps-Dense has two potential limitations.
The first is that, without task-specific relevance examples, the LLM lacks sufficient knowledge of what relevance “looks like” for a given search task, making it difficult to generate representative words that are well aligned with the retrieval objective. The second limitation is that PromptReps relies on an instruction alone, without any shared context to connect the query and document encoding tasks; each encoding task is performed independently without knowledge of how the other represents text, which may limit how well their inner products can capture relevance.
blocks.zh:
我们假设"快速回击"有两个潜在的局限性
第一,没有具体任务的相关实例,LLM对特定搜索任务“看起来”的相关性缺乏足够的了解,因此很难生成与检索目标完全一致的代表性词。 第二个限制是,ExpointReps只依靠一个指令,没有任何共享的上下文来连接查询和文档编码任务;每个编码任务都是独立完成的,而不知道对方代表文本的方式,这可能会限制其内产物能够如何捕捉相关性.

blocks.en: 2.2 RICE
blocks.zh: 2.2 危险

blocks.en: To overcome these challenges, we propose RICE. The core hypothesis underlying RICE is that just a few in-context examples of query–document pairs, accompanied by PromptReps-generated representative words, can provide enough shared context to prime the LLM to produce query and document representations whose inner products better reflect relevance, while also exposing the model to task- and domain-specific language.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些挑战,我们提议 " 减少危险 " 。 RICE的核心假设是,只有几个查询-文件对的内文实例,加上即时Reps生成的代表性单词,可以提供足够的共享上下文,为LLM提供素材,生成内在产品能更好地反映相关性的查询和文档表达,同时将模型暴露于任务和域特定语言.

blocks.en: RICE operates as follows. First, building on the setup from Dai et al. (2023) , we assume access to a few task-specific query-document pairs, { ( q 1 , d 1 ) , ( q 2 , d 2 ) , … , ( q i , d i ) } \{(q_{1},d_{1}),(q_{2},d_{2}),\ldots,(q_{i},d_{i})\} , where q i q_{i} denotes a human -annotated query for document d i d_{i} . Next, for each document d i d_{i} in the task-specific exemplar pairs, we use the PromptReps document encoding prompt to generate a representative word w i w_{i} . This yields a set of in-context exemplars, f = { ( q 1 , d 1 , w 1 ) , ( q 2 , d 2 , w 2 ) , … , ( q i , d i , w i ) } f=\{(q_{1},d_{1},w_{1}),(q_{2},d_{2},w_{2}),\ldots,(q_{i},d_{i},w_{i})\} . These exemplars, f f , are then incorporated into the RICE prompt template, P RICE ​ ( f , x ) P_{\mathrm{RICE}}(f,x) , as in-context demonstrations, where each pair ( q i , d i ) (q_{i},d_{i}) serves as an example user input, w i w_{i} serves as the corresponding example assistant output, and x x is the query or document to be encoded:

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: Our experiments aim to study whether LLMs, using only in-context examples, can be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval without the need for additional training.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验旨在研究是否可以鼓励只使用文字中的例子的有限责任公司为密集检索提供有效的表述,而不需要更多的培训。

blocks.en: We implement RICE using Qwen3-8B Yang et al. (2025) and Qwen3.5-9B Qwen Team (2026) , with thinking disabled.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Qune3-8B Yang等人(2025年)和Qune3.5-9B Quen Team(2026年)实施RICE,思维残疾.

blocks.en: To derive in-context examples, we use the Promptagator Dai et al. (2023) ; Gwon et al. (2025) setup, selecting examples from the training or development split when available and from the test split otherwise. For datasets in which the query–document pairs are drawn from the test set, when encoding a given query or document at inference time, we replace any in-context example that includes that query or document “in-place” with another sampled example that excludes it, so RICE is never exposed to a test judgment involving that query or document during its encoding. We leverage 10 in-context examples to generate 𝐞 q f \mathbf{e}_{q}^{\,f} and 𝐞 d f \mathbf{e}_{d}^{\,f} .
blocks.zh: 为了得出内容内的例子,我们采用“促进者戴等人(2023年);Gwon等人(2025年)”的设置,从培训或开发的分拆中选取实例,从测试的分拆中选取实例。 对于从测试集中提取查询-文档对的数据集,当在推断时间对某一查询或文档进行编码时,我们将包含该查询或文档“就位”的任何内文示例替换为排除该查询或文档的另一个抽样示例,因此RICE在编码期间从未接触到涉及该查询或文档的测试判断. 我们利用 10 个内容中的例子生成 e q f\ mathbf{e}_{q}^{\,f} 和 e d\mathbf{e}_{d}^{\,f} 。

blocks.en: We consider 10 retrieval datasets from BEIR Thakur et al. (2021) . The retrieval tasks include news retrieval (TREC-News, Robust04), financial question answering (FiQA), biomedical IR (TREC-COVID, NFCorpus), fact checking (SciFact), citation prediction (SCIDOCS), tweet retrieval (Signal-1M), argument retrieval (ArguAna), and question answering (NQ). For metrics, we report Recall@100 across all experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑从BEIR Thakur等人(2021年)获取10个检索数据集。 检索任务包括新闻检索(TREC-News,Robust04),财务问题回答(FiQA),生物医学IR(TREC-COVID,NFCorpus),事实检查(Scifact),引用预测(SCIDOCS),微博检索(Signal-1M),辩证检索(ArguAna),以及问题回答(NQ). 关于衡量标准,我们报告所有实验的Recall@100。

blocks.en: Our primary point of comparison is the dense variant of PromptReps Zhuang et al. (2024) (PromptReps-Dense), which provides a baseline for measuring how much in-context examples improve LLM-prompted dense representations over a zero-shot approach. To ensure that our comparison between RICE and PromptReps accounts for differences in prompt wording, we include a RICE (Zero-Shot) baseline which uses the same query and document prompts as RICE, but without any in-context examples. Notably, RICE (Zero-Shot) differs from PromptReps only in the prompt text.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要比较点是PowerReps Zhuang等人(2024年)(PromptReps-Dense)的稠密变体,该变体为衡量文字中的例子在零镜头方法的基础上改进LLM催化的稠密表示提供了基准. 为了确保我们比较RICE和Flaur Reps时能说明快速措辞的差异,我们列入了RICE(Zero-Shot)基线,它使用与RICE相同的查询和文件提示,但没有任何内文实例。 值得注意的是,RICE(Zero-Shot)仅在即时文本中不同于即时回放.

blocks.en: We next evaluate RICE against methods which utilize self-supervised or synthetic LLM-generated data to train a downstream dense retriever. The first method is LLM2Vec-Gen BehnamGhader et al. (2026) , a self-supervised approach for enabling decoder-only LLMs to produce dense representations by training them to represent a potential response to a given query rather than the query itself. The second method is Promptodile Gwon et al. (2025) ; Dai et al. (2023) , which in-context prompts LLMs offline to generate synthetic training data that is aligned with the target corpora for training dense retrievers.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将对照使用自我监督或合成LLM生成的数据来训练下游密集检索器的方法对RICE进行评估。 第一种方法是LLM2Vec-Gen BehnamGhader et al. (2026),这是一种自我监督的方法,通过对解码器唯一的LLMs进行训练以代表对特定查询的潜在响应而不是查询本身来产生密集的表示. 第二种方法是Pournodile Gwon et al.(2025);Dai et al.(2023),其内文本促使LLMs下线,生成与目标corpora一致的合成训练数据,用于培训密集的检索器.

blocks.en: We then consider fully zero-shot dense retrieval methods where LLMs are leveraged as a tool to improve query representations for existing unsupervised encoders. These include HyDE Gao et al. (2023) , which enriches the query representation using LLM-generated hypothetical answer documents; PRF- Umbrela Jedidi and Lin (2026) , which utilizes an LLM relevance judge to select top-retrieved documents for refining the query representation; and CSQE Lei et al. (2024) , which refines the query using both LLM-generated hypothetical answer documents and an LLM relevance judge. 1 1 1 For CSQE, we use the Umbrela -HyDE adaptation from Jedidi and Lin (2026) . These baselines follow the implementation details described in Jedidi and Lin (2026) , leveraging the unsupervised Contriever Izacard et al. (2022) as the dense retriever with Rocchio vector feedback Li et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将考虑完全零射致密检索方法,利用LLMs作为工具,改进对现有无监督编码器的查询表示。 其中包括HyDE Gao等人(2023年),利用LLM生成的假设答案文件丰富了查询表达方式;PRF-Umbrela Jedidi和Lin(2026年),利用LLM相关法官选择顶级检索文件,以完善查询表达方式;CSQE Lei等人(2024年),利用LLM生成的假设答案文件和LLM相关法官对查询方式进行了改进. 1,1 对于CSQE,我们使用来自绝地语和Lin(2026年)的Umbrela-HyDE改编. 这些基线遵循了绝地迪和林(2026年)中描述的实施细节,利用无人监管的康特里韦尔·伊扎卡尔等人(2022年)作为密集的检索器与Rocchio矢量反馈李等人(2022年).

blocks.en: Lastly, we consider BGE-base-en-v1.5 Xiao et al. (2024) and Qwen3-Embedding-8B Zhang et al. (2025) as “upper bounds” on dense retriever effectiveness. Both systems have been fine-tuned using state-of-the-art dense retriever training pipelines on large amounts of data. BM25 is included as an unsupervised sparse retrieval baseline.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们认为BGE-base-en-v1.5 Xiao 等人(2024年)和Qune3-Embedding-8B Zhang 等人(2025年)对于密集的回收机效能来说是“超限的”。 这两个系统都利用大量数据的最先进的密集检索器培训管道进行了微调。 BM25作为无监督的稀疏检索基线列入.

blocks.en: We utilize vLLM Kwon et al. (2023) for LLM inference, FAISS Douze et al. (2025) for indexing and search, and Pyserini Lin et al. (2021) for its BM25 implementation and retrieval evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们利用vLLM Kwon等人(2023年)进行LLM推论,FAISS Douze等人(2025年)进行索引和检索,Pyserini Lin等人(2021年)进行BM25的执行和检索评价。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Experimental results are shown in Table 1 . Overall, we find that RICE demonstrates strong effectiveness across BEIR tasks, achieving the highest average Recall@100 among the evaluated methods that require no training.
blocks.zh: 实验结果见表1。 总而言之,我们发现,REICE在BEIR任务中表现出强大的效力,在无需培训的评估方法中实现了最高的平均值Recall@100。

blocks.en: In particular, RICE improves upon PromptReps-Dense with both Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, yielding gains of 3.6 and 2.4 points in Recall@100, respectively, demonstrating that in-context examples improve the effectiveness of dense representations derived from prompting LLMs. The 3.6-point improvement of RICE (Qwen3.5-9B) over RICE Zero-Shot (Qwen3.5-9B) confirms that this improvement can be attributed to the inclusion of in-context examples rather than to differences between the RICE and PromptReps prompts.
blocks.zh: 特别是,RICE改进了快速Reps-Dense的Qune3-8B和Qune3.5-9B,在Recall@100中分别收获3.6分和2.4分,表明文字中的例子提高了从促进LLMs中得出的密集表示的有效性. RICE(Quen3.5-9B)比RICE Zero-Shot(Quen3.5-9B)的3.6点改进证实了这一改进可以归因于包含内容内的例子,而不是由于RICE和FlaidReps points之间的差异.

blocks.en: Beyond methods which derive dense representations directly from LLMs, RICE is also more effective than HyDE, PRF- Umbrela , and CSQE, three approaches that instead utilize LLMs as a tool to improve query representations for existing unsupervised encoders. Interestingly, this boost is larger when RICE utilizes Qwen3.5-9B instead of Qwen3-8B. One possible explanation, as argued by Shen et al. (2024) , is that such methods are constrained by the representational capacity of the unsupervised encoder. RICE does not have this bottleneck as it does not rely on a separate encoder and thus can directly take advantage of improved LLM backbones.
blocks.zh: 除了直接从LLMs中得出密集表示的方法外,RICE还比HyDE、PRF-Umbrela和CSQE更为有效,它们有三种方法,它们利用LLMs作为工具,改进对现有无监督编码者的查询表示。 有趣的是,当RICE使用Quen3.5-9B而不是Quen3-8B时,这种提速更大. 如Shen等人(2024年)所述,一种可能的解释是,这种方法受到无监督编码器代表能力的制约。 RICE没有这个瓶颈,因为它不依赖单独的编码器,因此可以直接利用改进的LLM骨干.

blocks.en: When compared against methods trained using self-supervision or synthetic data, RICE achieves competitive retrieval effectiveness. In particular, when compared with LLM2Vec-Gen using the same Qwen3-8B backbone, RICE performs on par, on average. Using Qwen3.5-9B, RICE can improve upon LLM2Vec-Gen by 1.6 points in average Recall@100. Notably, for RICE, this improvement comes “for free”, as it only requires another round of indexing, while LLM2Vec-Gen would need to undergo another round of self-supervised training. Across the five overlapping datasets, RICE achieves higher average Recall@100 than Promptodile, with gains on NFCorpus and SCIDOCS.
blocks.zh: 与使用自监控或合成数据培训的方法相比,RICE实现了竞争性检索的有效性。 特别是,与使用同一Quen3-8B主干线的LLM2Vec-Gen相比,RICE平均表现相当。 使用Quen3.5-9B,RICE可以在LLM2Vec-Gen上提高平均回转@100的1.6分. 值得注意的是,对RICE来说,这种改进是“免费的”,因为它只需要再进行一轮索引编制,而LLM2Vec-Gen则需要接受另一轮自我监督的培训。 在整个五个重叠数据集中,REICE实现了高于Powerodile的平均值Recall@100,在NFCorpus和SCIDOCS上有所收获.

blocks.en:
When evaluated against state-of-the-art dense retrievers that were trained using vast amounts of high-quality data (BGE-base-en-v1.5 and Qwen3-Embedding-8B), RICE lags behind.
Nevertheless, we highlight that our results indicate that RICE can provide a strong middle ground between approaches requiring no retriever training and those that rely on dedicated retriever training.
blocks.zh:
在对使用大量高质量数据(BGE-base-en-v1.5和Qune3-Embedding-8B)培训的最先进的密集检索器进行评价时,RICE落后了.
然而,我们强调,我们的结果表明,国际康复会可以提供一种强有力的中间点,即无需回收人员培训的办法与依赖专用回收人员培训的办法之间。

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: In our experiments, we leverage 10 in-context examples for query and document encoding. We now investigate the effectiveness of RICE when varying the number of in-context examples used for generating 𝐞 q f \mathbf{e}_{q}^{\,f} . The results are in Figure 1 . Generally, the accuracy of RICE improves as the number of in-context examples increases, but can begin to decrease when utilizing 20 examples.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们利用10个文本中的例子进行查询和文件编码。 我们现在在对生成 e q f\ mathbf{ e}_{q}^{\q}^{\, f} 使用 e q f\ mathbf\\ q}^{\, f} 的文本实例数量进行修改时, 调查 RICE 的有效性 。 结果见图1。 一般来说,随着文本中实例数量的增加,RICE的准确性得到了提高,但在使用20个实例时可以开始下降.

blocks.en: In Table 2 we investigate whether dynamically selecting query- or document-specific examples can improve RICE. To study this, before encoding a query or document, we utilize BM25 to retrieve the top-10 most similar examples – i.e., most similar queries for query-specific selection and documents for document-specific selection – from the training exemplar pool, which then get paired with their representative word w i w_{i} to construct f f .
blocks.zh: 在表2中,我们调查动态选择查询或文档特定实例是否能够改进RICE。 为了研究这一点,在编码查询或文档之前,我们利用BM25从训练实例库中检索到10个最相似的例子,即:最相似的查询用于特定查询的选择和文档选择,然后用它们的代表性单词w i w_{i}来构建f f 。

blocks.en:
The results show that dynamic in-context example selection can improve RICE’s effectiveness across FiQA, NFCorpus, and SciFact. We note that
the primary gains appear to come when utilizing dynamic exemplars for query encoding, and utilizing dynamic exemplars on only the document side appears to hurt effectiveness, compared to a fixed set of examples.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,动态的内文本实例选择可以提高RICE在整个FiQA、NFCorpus和SciFact的效能。 我们注意到,
当使用动态实例进行查询编码时,以及仅使用文档一侧的动态实例似乎有损于有效性时,主要收益似乎就会出现,而只是一组固定实例。

blocks.en:
Next, we investigate the composition of different in-context exemplars for RICE, exploring
three settings: (1) Non-Relevant , in which documents judged relevant to one query are paired with different queries for which they are unjudged; (2) Mixed , which combines five relevant and five non-relevant examples; and (3) Random , where queries and documents are independently sampled from the query set and full corpus, respectively, while excluding judged query-document pairs.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们调查 不同内容的构成 为RICE实例,探索
三种设置: (1)非关联性,其中判断与一个查询相关的文件与未被判断的不同查询配对; (2)混合性,将5个相关和5个无关的例子合在一起; (3)随机性,分别从查询集和全集中独立抽查查询和文件,同时排除判断的查询文件配对.

blocks.en: The results are in Table 3 . Interestingly, we find that all same-corpus variations of example pairs are stronger than using no in-context examples. Most surprising is that we see no clear advantage to using relevant example pairs versus the other alternatives.
blocks.zh: 结果见表3。 有趣的是,我们发现所有相同的公司 变异的例对 都比不使用内在的例强。 最令人惊讶的是,我们看不出使用相关实例对替代方案有明显的好处。

blocks.en: We believe an explanation for this result is that RICE is effective because of the task- and domain-specific language present in the examples, and not necessarily the accuracy of the examples. This would be consistent with the findings from Min et al. (2022) , who showed that ground-truth demonstrations are not needed for effective in-context learning and that providing the LLM with in-distribution inputs is more critical.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,这一结果的一个解释是,RICE是有效的,因为实例中存在任务和域特定语言,而不一定是实例的准确性. 这与Min等人(2022年)的调查结果是一致的,他们表明,无需进行地面真实的演示来进行有效的文字学习,向LLM提供分配投入更为关键。

blocks.en: To test this hypothesis, we explore using relevant cross-corpus demonstrations, i.e., relevant query-document pairs from another corpus, denoted by Relevant (cross-corpus) in Table 3 . We find this to be less effective than all variations of same-corpus example pairs, which further supports our hypothesis that the benefit of in-context demonstrations depends more on corpus-specific information than on query–document relevance alone: in-domain negative (non-relevant and random) demonstrations outperform relevant cross-corpus demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这一假设,我们利用相关的跨公司演示,即表3中相关(跨公司)表示的来自另一实体的相关查询文件对。 我们发现这比同公司实例对的所有变异效果都差, 这进一步支持了我们的假设, 即内文演示的好处更多地取决于针对具体实体的信息, 而不是仅凭查询文件的相关性: 域内负面(无关和随机)演示比相关的跨公司演示要好。

blocks.en: The previous experiment suggests that selecting query-document pairs from the same corpus can matter more than their relevance relationships. Here, we further investigate this by studying the tradeoff between domain-specific language and the accuracy of in-context examples, probing the choice – and importance – of w i w_{i} . We investigate four variants: (1) Shuffled , which permutes the original word labels across exemplars; (2) Fixed , which assigns the same word to every exemplar; (3) Blank , which replaces each word label with an empty string while retaining all demonstrations; and (4) Random , which assigns ten distinct, unrelated words to the ten exemplars.
blocks.zh: 之前的实验表明,从同一个本体中选择查询-文档对可以比它们的相关性关系更重要. 在这里,我们通过研究特定域语言与内容中实例的准确性之间的权衡来进一步调查这一点,探索wi i i i i i i i 的选择和重要性。 我们调查了四个变体: (1)Shuffled,它将原始的单词标签贯穿于示例中; (2)Fixd,它为每个示例中分配同一个单词; (3)Blank,它将每个单词标签替换为空字符串,同时保留所有演示; (4)Random,它为十个示例中分配了十个不同的,无关的单词.

blocks.en: Table 4: Representative word ablations for RICE with Qwen3.5-9B. Random sets w 1 , … , w 10 w_{1},\dots,w_{10} to feather, basket, curtain, candle, window, compass, marble, lantern, violin, and saddle.
blocks.zh: 表4: 以Quen3.5-9B为代表的RICE文字。 随机设定W 1,... ,W 10 w_{1},\dots,w_{10}到羽毛,篮子,窗帘,蜡烛,窗户,罗盘,大理石,灯笼,小提琴,和鞍。

blocks.en: The results can be found in Table 4 . We find that shuffling the word labels across the existing in-context examples or setting the labels to blank has little impact on the effectiveness of RICE. On the other hand, assigning distinct, unrelated words substantially reduces the effectiveness of RICE. Interestingly, using a fixed, random word has a less negative effect, although we note that its effect depends on both the choice of word and the dataset. One possible explanation for this could be that, when using a fixed word, there is no varying exemplar-specific signal, and the model can disregard the fixed word as “noise”.
blocks.zh: 结果见表4。 我们发现,在现有的内文示例中打乱字词标签,或将标签设为空白,对RICE的有效性影响不大. 另一方面,指定不同、无关的词大大降低了国际天主教儿童研究中心的效力。 有趣的是,使用固定的,随机的单词具有较少的负面效果,尽管我们注意到其效果既取决于词的选择,也取决于数据集. 一种可能的解释是,在使用固定词时,没有不同的具体实例信号,模型可以忽略固定词作为“噪声”。

blocks.en: Together with the ( q , d ) (q,d) composition results, these findings suggest that the task- and domain-specific language in RICE is more critical than the actual accuracy of the in-context examples. In the case of selecting w i w_{i} , accurate exemplar-word associations are not the most essential component.
blocks.zh: 连同(q,d) (q,d)组成结果,这些调查结果表明,RICE中针对任务和域的具体语言比内文实例的实际准确性更为关键. 在选择 w i i i i i i 的情况下,准确的示例词协会并不是最基本的组成部分.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce RICE, a simple approach for deriving effective dense representations from LLMs using only in-context examples. Empirical results demonstrate that RICE can improve the accuracy of prompt-based LLM dense retrievers while also outperforming other strong “training-free” dense retrieval baselines. While fully supervised dense retrievers trained on large collections of high-quality relevance data remain more effective, our findings show that in-context examples can help narrow this gap. We believe RICE represents an exciting direction for building dense retrieval systems that do not require retriever training and can easily adapt to new tasks and domains.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍RICE, 这是一种简单的方法, 仅用文中的例子从法学硕士中得出有效的密集表述。 经验结果表明,RICE可以提高快速LLM密度检索器的准确性,同时也比其他强的“无培训”密度检索基线要好。 虽然在大量收集高质量相关数据方面接受过全面监督的密集检索器仍然更有效,但我们的研究结果表明,文中的例子有助于缩小这一差距。 我们相信RICE代表着建设密集检索系统的令人振奋的方向,这些系统不需要检索者培训,可以轻松适应新的任务和领域.
